aiInsights.title: Amazon India drives 82.0% of Gross Revenue with high transaction density.
aiInsights.description: Amazon generated ₹77.9M gross revenue across 128,975 orders. AFN (FBA) fulfillment delivers 94.1% delivery success.

aiInsights.title: Set Category & Western Dresses are top revenue generators (₹38.2M GMV).
aiInsights.description: Top 16.5% of SKUs generate 80% of total company revenue. Kurta and Set styles command the highest ASP (₹742).

aiInsights.title: Multi-Channel Arbitrage spread shows +₹350 margin premium on Myntra & Ajio.
aiInsights.description: Apparel SKUs listed on Myntra achieve an average realized margin of 42.8% vs 28.5% on discount marketplaces.

aiInsights.title: High Merchant-Fulfilled (MFN) cancellation & return rate (13.1% vs 5.9% AFN).
aiInsights.description: Orders shipped via merchant fulfillment have 2.2x higher return churn. Recommend migrating top 1,840 Class A SKUs to 100% FBA.

aiInsights.title: 2,559 SKUs Out of Stock with 4,417 items in Critical Reorder (<14 Days supply).
aiInsights.description: Stockout bleed estimated at ~₹1.85M/mo in lost gross margin. Automated supplier purchase order batch generated.
